record.question: The number of seats in the Lok Sabha is
record.explanation: Answer C: 545. At the June 2019 sitting, the conventional contemporaneous figure of 545 meant 543 elected MPs plus two nominated Anglo-Indian members. The question is imprecise because it does not distinguish then-current composition from elected seats or constitutional maximum. Reference: https://sansad.in/ls/about/house-composition. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: June 2019 (cover; exact day not printed). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
